t: Pre-assembled 50cm lengths. Spikes are made from premium-grade stainless steel. Deter nuisance birds with this humane solution. Easily fixed to guttering, window sills or walls to prevent birds from landing. Flexible snap to size base, ideal for curved edges. Fixed into place with screws or glue (not supplied). Reliable method of keeping buildings free of birds of all types. UV-resistant, GE-produced plastic.
